title: C2 Beaconing Alert
description: Standardized alert emitted by the passive C2-beaconing detectors (fast 60s/10s and deep 300s/60s). One alert per flagged unit (window_start, orig_h, resp_h, resp_p, proto) at window close.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 window-close time (window_start + window_s). The moment the alert becomes available.

window_start.description: ISO-8601 start of the observation window that produced the alert.

detector_id.description: Detector instance id, e.g. c2_60s_10s or c2_300s_60s.

timescale.description: Human-facing timescale label. The two channels are INDEPENDENT; scores are never fused.

flow_id.description: Zeek uid(s) of the flows that contributed to this unit. CONTEXT ONLY - never a model feature.

confidence.description: HistGradientBoosting predict_proba[:,1] for the unit. Compared against the artifact's fixed validation-selected threshold.

unit.description: The grouping key. IPs/ports are CONTEXT for the analyst and dashboard correlation, never model features.

features.description: The 13 passive behavioral features that produced the score. Null where undefined for the unit (too few flows/gaps).
